studio.title: The studio
studio.lead: CloudSheep is the one-person product studio of Dušan Pavlović — engineer of electrical engineering and computing, University of Niš.
studio.body: You work directly with the person who designs the interface, writes the code and answers for the result. One brain holding the whole product means decisions are fast, context never gets lost, and quality has a single owner.

onePerson.q: Is it really just one person?
onePerson.a: Yes. Design, frontend, backend and deployment are all done by me. For larger scopes I bring in trusted collaborators, but you always have one point of contact and one person accountable for the result.

designDev.q: Do you do design and development together?
designDev.a: That is the point of the studio. The person drawing the interface is the person building it, so nothing gets lost in a handoff and nothing gets designed that cannot be built.

platforms.a: Yes. Depending on the project we use React Native for one shared codebase, or fully native Kotlin and Swift when the product needs it. The choice is made per project, not per habit.

duration.q: How long does a project take?
duration.a: A design sprint is one to two weeks. A typical fixed-scope product runs eight to sixteen weeks from discovery to launch. You get a written estimate after the first call.

ownership.a: You do. Everything is delivered in your repository, with documentation, and the license is yours from day one. No lock-in and no rented infrastructure.

location.q: Where are you based — and what about timezones?
location.a: Niš, Serbia (CET). That overlaps the whole European working day and mornings in North America. Async by default, calls whenever they are actually useful.

contact.title: One studio. One person. Whole product.
